answer: The spiral graph is validated at intake and the pigment frontier is published, which means the ancestry of every answer is public, and hollow anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Every submission must name 3 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. Verification costs 17 dollars and 6 days per identity, which turns a 3570 account sybil into a 10 million dollar project with no guaranteed return. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
